content_of_post_to_answer: Should young people be encouraged to play team sports to build soft skills such as empathy?
answer: Team sports can build empathy, but the lesson is not simply learning to cooperate; it is learning to see that other people experience the same situation differently. A teammate may be tired, anxious, frustrated, or seeing a play unfold in a way you do not. The deeper skill is not teamwork itself, but the ability to adjust your own perspective while still working toward a shared goal. Sports are valuable because they create repeated moments where understanding others becomes necessary, not just desirable.
